Welcome to FAZAG Schools

Science • Technology • Character • Skills

A Warm Welcome from Our School Family

Welcome to FAZAG Schools of Science and Technical Skills, a place where curiosity is nurtured, talents are discovered, and every child is prepared for a bright future.

We combine sound academic learning with practical, hands-on technical skills, guided by dedicated teachers and strong moral values. We invite you to explore our school, meet our family, and join us in raising confident, capable and responsible leaders of tomorrow.

🔬 Science

Hands-on learning that sparks curiosity and critical thinking.

🛠️ Technical Skills

Practical skills that prepare learners for real life and work.

🌟 Character

Discipline, integrity and respect at the heart of all we do.

About Us

Admin mode is on: click any dashed text below and type. Then click "Publish changes" at the bottom.

Our History

Fazag School of Science and Technical Skills was founded in 2023 by Mallam Zakariya Kilishi as an Islamic school during its first year, the institution subsequently expanded its curriculum to integrate Western education, offering a blended approach to learning and technical skill development.

Our Vision

To be an institution of global learning for both academic and Technical skills where staff and students strive to fully discover and develop their potentials and talents to benefit humanity


Our Mission

To nurture morally grounded, technically competent, and visionary leaders equipped with practical skills for global impact

Our Values

  • Uniqueness
  • Integrity
  • Excellence
  • Discipline
  • Innovation

Our Targets

  • On every child, our first target is the ability to identify and blend letters
  • Our second target is the ability to read fluently
  • Our next target is the ability to write what they can read
  • Our following target is practical application of what they have learnt in real life situation.
